id: wikimedia:File:2011-06-05 19-32 Berlin TXL Airplane Flyover plus Wingtip Vortex.ogg
providerId: File:2011-06-05 19-32 Berlin TXL Airplane Flyover plus Wingtip Vortex.ogg
title: 2011-06-05 19-32 Berlin TXL Airplane Flyover plus Wingtip Vortex
creator: Fritz Schlüter
description: Excerpt from a field recording that I took at Berlin Tegel Airport in June 2011, standing next to the Western airport fence where the airplanes fly over landing (if there is easterly wind). The sound of the airplane is quite intense. However, the crucial part of this recording starts at 50 seconds: closely following the direct noise of the airplane you can hear the subtle sound of the wake vortex (or: wing tip vortex, which is a trail of turbulent air behind an airplane). The wake vortex creates a flimsy swish and rustle. However, its sound is not always so articulate and continuous as it was this time. It lasts from 0’50 to the end of the recording.
attribution: “2011-06-05 19-32 Berlin TXL Airplane Flyover plus Wingtip Vortex” by Fritz Schlüter (CC BY-SA 3.0) — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:2011-06-05_19-32_Berlin_TXL_Airplane_Flyover_plus_Wingtip_Vortex.ogg

title: Dawn Chorus 2020-05-31 0341 0658
creator: Robert EA Harvey
description: The blackbirds have stopped singing, as have the thrushes, because we are suddenly in Summer, not Spring. But I am still Covid-19 isolating, and have been loathe to make long recordings as I am about to run out of batteries. I have now devised an external battery pack and made a recording just over 3 hours long of the summer dawn chorus, starting at 03:41. It is less exciting than the spring one, but more varied. I apologise for the passing cars, but I can't stop them, and the Covid-19 shutdown is still having a useful effect on traffic. This recording accompanies geograph image File:Dawn in Beech Avenue - geograph.org.uk - 6492374.jpg taken at the start of the recording
attribution: “Dawn Chorus 2020-05-31 0341 0658” by Robert EA Harvey (CC BY-SA 4.0) — https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Dawn_Chorus_2020-05-31_0341_0658.mp3

title: Garden sounds during Covid19 220-05-08 1100
creator: Robert EA Harvey
description: A recording made that starts just before the 11:00 silence on the 75th anniversary of VE day. It is the sounds in my back garden. Mostly birdsong, the odd hoverfly buzz, and (after the silence) the distant murmur of neighbours, and the sound of people on the public footpath next to my home. This recording accompanies Geograph images File:Trunk of weeping willow in my garden - geograph.org.uk - 6466311.jpg and File:Recording setup - geograph.org.uk - 6466323.jpg - taken at the same time
